name: scheduler
description: Authenticated loopback scheduler with cron, one-shot date, and fixed-interval triggers backed by authoritative SQLite Job and Run records

capabilities.name: scheduler.cron
capabilities.description: Persist, restore, pause, resume, and execute five-field cron jobs

capabilities.name: scheduler.date
capabilities.description: Execute an aware one-shot ISO 8601 date job and persist completed or error terminal state

capabilities.name: scheduler.interval
capabilities.description: Execute a bounded fixed-second interval job with persisted next-run metadata

capabilities.name: scheduler.manual_run
capabilities.description: Trigger asynchronous manual runs and poll the same authoritative run_id

capabilities.name: scheduler.timezone
capabilities.description: Resolve request, AGENT_FORGE_USER_TZ, TZ, system, then UTC and normalize date runs to UTC

credentials.description: Optional explicit bearer token; a random local token is generated otherwise

health_checks.description: Verify scheduler dependencies, trigger schema, authentication, and SQLite state

storage.description: Single source of truth for trigger definitions, executions, terminal states, and migrations
Generated daemon bearer token; never print its value
